maria (AE): kickoff: RetailEdge POC asks — streaming SDK + tool/function calls + strict structured JSON output. Need EU-only data, IP allowlist, short-lived creds, and a pricing delta for reserved vs hosted.

eva_ops: constraints: steady 180 qps, spikes to 1k qps during promos, webhooks in eu-west with bearer token auth, CIDR 198.51.100.0/24.

henry (SE): streaming + toolcall flow supported. minimal Go snippet for handling a tool call: `ev := <-stream.Events(); if ev.Type==ToolCall { res := callWebhook(ev.Args); stream.SendToolResult(ev.Tool, res) }`

ali (DevEx): recommend `schema_enforce: strict` to avoid downstream parsing errors. Small tip: use incremental tool responses for long enrichments to avoid timeouts.

henry (SE): capacity rec: start hosted with autoscale, move to reserved pool sized for 250 qps sustained + burst buffer. Will DM concrete numbers.

ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled 2024-12-10T06:00Z -> eu-west-1. Monitor: p95 latency, toolcall error-rate.

maria (AE): action items: 1) henry: sample apps (go/node/python) + migration notes (ETA: 24h). 2) ali: cost comparison hosted vs reserved (ETA: 48h). 3) eva: provide webhook CIDRs + security contact (ETA: today).

eva_ops: will share CIDRs and loop in sec contact (nora@retailedge.com). pairing at 15:30 CET tomorrow works.

maria (AE): thanks everyone 44D — will keep thread updated.
